subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting CRT and C++-runtime helper objects shared across the engine: extended-precision floating-point arithmetic and formatting, a block of Winsock2 import-address-table thunks, MSVC stream-object (iostream/streambuf) construction, destruction and buffered-read internals, SEH frame dispatch helpers, and a family of one-line delegation/conversion thunks that forward to shared helpers. No single owning game subsystem is evidenced; every function owner in the packet is UnknownObject.

summary: Forty-three runtime-object helper functions that do not belong to a specific game subsystem. Six functions form an extended-precision x87 floating-point cluster (division with overflow fixup, FPREM-style remainder core, denormal-scaling modulus, double classification, and float display formatting). Eight functions are Winsock2 import thunks forwarding through IAT globals at 0x0059E2CC-0x0059E310. Seven functions are MSVC stream-object internals keyed on the std::ios/std::streambuf vtables (0x005B9BB4, 0x005B9C04) and the buffered-stream layout (vtable +0, get pointer +0x1C, remaining count +0x2C). Fifteen functions are one-line delegation/conversion thunks, most converging on the shared helpers BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and VTableInitOnly (0x00598E2E); four more are constructor/vtable-fixup pass-through thunks. Two functions sit on the SEH exception-frame dispatch path. All owners are UnknownObject; class groupings below are DERIVED from call shape, identical wrapper structure, ABI labels, and shared IAT/vtable evidence, not from proven shared ownership.

function_roles.role: Float-to-display-string formatting wrapper: loads the double argument through CRTFload and formats it via Trandisp1, finalizing through sub_590703; display context unknown (no callers recorded).
80-bit extended-precision division returning a double, with mantissa normalization and lookup-table/scale-constant overflow fixup so the quotient stays within double range.
Wrapper that stores two x87-register doubles into local TBYTE scratch buffers and calls the extended-precision division fixup routine with pointers to them; void return.

Core extended-precision FPREM-style remainder reducer: classifies operands through byte_5E74FC and exponent masks, then reduces via scaled subtraction or direct x87 FPREM depending on the exponent gap; reloads the x87 environment on low flag bits.
Double modulus wrapper: non-zero divisor exponent takes a fast path into the remainder core; otherwise zero/denormal inputs are detected and both operands scaled by dbl_5E7514 with scale flags 2/3.

Double-precision classification routine: inspects a2's exponent bits, dispatches to FloatingPointRemainder with mode 0, or scales both operands by dbl_5E7514 and dispatches with mode 2/3; zero a2 returns a low-word combination directly.

Runtime introspection helper: validates the running image MZ/e_lfanew headers and copies the PE optional-header Major/MinorLinkerVersion bytes into a two-byte caller buffer; returns the minor version byte on success.
SEH frame-path helper: runs frame-setup sub_588931, dispatches an indirect frame handler, normalizes a 256 type code to 2, and reruns sub_588931; used by both SEH exception-frame callers.

Trivial stub returning the constant 1 and ignoring its argument; the packet names LongjmpMSVCCRT as sole caller, suggesting an SEH/longjmp default-handler placeholder, but that purpose is not evidenced.
Bit-field merge wrapper: masks the second argument with 0xFFF7FFFF then delegates to the bit-field mask-merge routine.
Thin delegation wrapper forwarding a1, a2 and global dword_5E99B8 to sub_5953B8 and returning its result.

Locale/format wrapper: unpacks an 80-bit float via Float80ToFloat64Unpack, formats it through sub_5976E8 into a character buffer, and packs length, first char, buffer value and a forwarded word into a caller-provided _DWORD output record.
Trivial cdecl forwarding wrapper passing its char argument plus fixed constants 0 and 4 to sub_596E0F and returning the result.
Bit-flag predicate: returns 1 when the byte flag intersects byte_8D47E1[a1] or when the word mask intersects word_5E69D2[a1]; used by the ThreeArgCallWrapper delegation path.
Winsock2 import thunk for ntohs: forwards the u_short argument through __imp_ntohs (0x0059E2CC) and returns its result.
Winsock import thunk for getsockname: forwards (s, name, namelen) through __imp_getsockname (0x0059E2D0) and returns the error code.
Winsock import thunk for bind: forwards (s, name, namelen) through __imp_bind (0x0059E2D4) and returns the error code.
Winsock import thunk for htonl: forwards the hostlong through __imp_htonl (0x0059E2D8) and returns the network-byte-order result.
stdcall import thunk for gethostbyname: forwards the host-name string through __imp_gethostbyname (0x0059E2EC) and returns the hostent pointer.
Winsock2 import thunk for connect: forwards (s, name, namelen) through __imp_connect (0x0059E2FC) and returns its result.
Winsock2 import thunk for setsockopt: forwards (s, level, optname, optval, optlen) through __imp_setsockopt (0x0059E308) and returns its result.
Winsock import thunk for inet_ntoa: converts an in_addr structure to a dotted-quad string through __imp_inet_ntoa (0x0059E310) and returns the string pointer.
One-line delegation stub calling VTableInitOnly (sub_598E2E) with the fixed constant 0 and returning its result.
Delegation wrapper passing the address of global PhysicsSolverInitStub (0x005986CB) to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the conversion result.
One-line delegation stub calling VTableInitOnly (sub_598E2E) with the fixed constant 0 and returning its result.
Delegation wrapper passing the address of global PhysicsStateWrapper (0x005986F8) to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the conversion result.
Direct delegation to ObjectConstructorWithSEHVtableInit with literal arguments 0 and 1; a zero-argument convenience constructor supplying a default first argument.
Pass-through thunk forwarding all four arguments unchanged to ConstructorWithVTableFixup (callee address not recorded in the packet) and returning its int result.
Pure forwarding thunk delegating all four arguments unchanged to VtableFixupWithDestructor and returning its result; callee address not evidenced.
One-line delegation stub calling VTableInitOnly (sub_598E2E) with the fixed constant 0 and returning its result.
Delegation wrapper reading global PhysicsStateUnkInit (0x005987AD), converting its value to int, passing it to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.
Delegation wrapper reading global StringPrintfThunk (0x005987DC), converting its value to int, passing it to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.
Forwarding wrapper passing the address of global dword_8D43C8 (cast to char*) plus four forwarded arguments to VtableFixupWithDestructor; callee address not evidenced.
Delegation wrapper reading global PhysicsThunk (0x0059880B), converting its value to int, passing it to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.
Stream-object constructor tail: writes the std::ios vftable pointer into this+0x0 and tail-jumps to a further initialization routine; invoked during stream-object construction from sub_59927C.

Streambuf destructor-stage vtable fixup: writes the std::streambuf vftable into this+0x0 and dispatches a virtual call through the locale sub-object at this+13; invoked from the streambuf destructor chain.
Streambuf uflow virtual method: dispatches the vtable slot-4 function (offset 0x10) to refill; on -1 returns immediately, otherwise reads one byte from the get area via MSVCStreambufGninc.

Buffered single-byte read: fast path returns the buffered byte at this+0x1C while the count at this+0x2C is positive; otherwise refills via vtable slot 5 (offset 0x14) and consumes through vtable slot 2 (offset 0x08).
C++-style destructor wrapper: runs base stream-object initialization via VtableSetSubCall, conditionally frees the object when flag bit 0 of a3 is set, and returns the object pointer.

Userpurge memory wrapper: backs up 8 bytes from the receiver to an offset header, runs ConstructorWithVTableFixup on that header, conditionally frees it via FreeWrapper when flag bit 0 is set, and returns the header pointer.
Trivial thunk converting the global EmptyStub_9796 value/address to an integer via BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.
Thin wrapper converting the address of global PhysicsStateCleanupWrapper to an integer, passing it to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.
Thin wrapper converting the address of global PhysicsStateAccessor to an integer, passing it to BooleanToIntConversion and returning the result.

classes.name: ExtendedPrecisionArithmetic
classes.responsibility: Extended-precision (80-bit x87) floating-point math helpers: division with overflow fixup, FPREM-style remainder reduction, and denormal-handling modulus wrappers.

classes.name: FloatFormatting
classes.responsibility: Float-to-text formatting wrappers: CRT display-format path (CRTFload/Trandisp1/sub_590703) and extended-float decimal packing into a caller output record (Float80ToFloat64Unpack/sub_5976E8).

classes.name: Winsock2ImportThunks
classes.responsibility: A contiguous block of Winsock/Winsock2 import-address-table thunks forwarding arguments unchanged to the imported entry points for network byte-order, socket naming, binding, name resolution, connection, options and address formatting.

classes.name: StreamObjectRuntime
classes.responsibility: MSVC iostream/streambuf stream-object internals: constructor tail that installs the std::ios vftable, destructor-stage vtable fixup with locale dispatch, the uflow/underflow virtual, a buffered single-byte read over the get-area layout, and conditional-free destructor/deallocation wrappers.

classes.name: CRTCallbackThunks
classes.responsibility: One-line delegation/conversion thunks, most converging on the shared helpers BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) or VTableInitOnly (0x00598E2E); the argument is either a fixed constant, a global value/address, or a converted global.

classes.name: VTableFixupConstructorThunks
classes.responsibility: Constructor and vtable-fixup pass-through thunks: convenience constructors and forwarding wrappers whose callees (ObjectConstructorWithSEHVtableInit, ConstructorWithVTableFixup, VtableFixupWithDestructor) are only partially evidenced in the packet.

classes.name: SehExceptionFrameHelpers
classes.responsibility: Helpers on the SEH exception-frame dispatch path: a frame-setup/finalize helper with indirect handler dispatch and type-code normalization, and a constant-1 success stub used by the longjmp/SEH path.

interfaces.name: Winsock2ImportTable
interfaces.purpose: Common surface over the eight Winsock import thunks: each forwards its arguments unchanged through an IAT pointer (0x0059E2CC-0x0059E310) to the corresponding imported ws2_32/wsock32 entry point and returns the imported result.

compatibility_contracts.name: ExtendedPrecisionDivisionOverflowFixup
compatibility_contracts.description: Division of 80-bit extended-precision operands must return a double within double range: mantissas are normalized (scaling by flt_5E74F8) until the integer bit is set, an exponent-class check through the byte_5E74E0 lookup table decides whether overflow fixup is needed, and both operands are scaled by flt_5E74F4 or flt_5E74F0 before dividing when the range is accepted.

compatibility_contracts.name: ExtendedPrecisionRemainder
compatibility_contracts.description: FPREM-style remainder over 80-bit operands: operand classification through byte_5E74FC and exponent masks, an exponent-gap decision between scaled subtraction (divisor scaled by dbl_5E752C) and direct x87 FPREM, and a reload of the x87 environment when the caller flag has low bits set. Callers select fast (mode 0) vs denormal-scale (modes 2/3, scaling by dbl_5E7514) paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: FloatDisplayFormatting
compatibility_contracts.description: Floating-point values are rendered through CRT display helpers: the CRT float display path loads a double via CRTFload and formats it through Trandisp1, while the locale/format path unpacks an 80-bit float via Float80ToFloat64Unpack and packs a fixed-width decimal string (limit 17) into a _DWORD output record holding length, first character, buffer value and a forwarded word.

compatibility_contracts.name: WinsockImportThunkForwards
compatibility_contracts.description: The eight Winsock thunks forward their arguments unchanged through the IAT pointer globals 0x0059E2CC-0x0059E310 to the corresponding imported entry points (ntohs, getsockname, bind, htonl, gethostbyname, connect, setsockopt, inet_ntoa) and return the imported result.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamObjectLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Stream objects place their vtable pointer at offset 0. Buffered read streams carry a get-area read pointer at +0x1C and a remaining-byte count at +0x2C. Refill is dispatched through vtable slot 5 (offset 0x14); slot 2 (offset 0x08) consumes the refilled byte; the uflow virtual refills through slot 4 (offset 0x10). The std::ios (0x005B9BB4) and std::streambuf (0x005B9C04) vtables are installed at construction/destruction stages.

compatibility_contracts.name: PeLinkerVersionIntrospection
compatibility_contracts.description: A runtime helper reads the current process image's PE optional-header MajorLinkerVersion and MinorLinkerVersion (bytes +26/+27) into a two-byte caller buffer after validating the MZ DOS signature and a non-zero e_lfanew; on a non-PE image the low byte of the module base is returned instead.

unresolved: Function owners are uniformly UnknownObject; the seven classes above are DERIVED from call shape, identical wrapper structure, ABI labels, and shared IAT/vtable evidence, not from proven shared ownership. Equal offsets on unrelated objects are not proof of a shared class.

Globals 0x008D4248, 0x008D42A0, 0x008D42D8, 0x008D4330, 0x008D4370, 0x0058895C and 0x005B99B8 are recorded as read by the wrapper thunks but do not appear in their decompiled bodies; treated as fill/analysis artifacts with no evidenced semantic role.
The five TEB-range global references (0xFF00000000001692 through 0xFF0000000000169B) recorded for EmptySuccessStub (0x00593D53) are compiler SEH/TEB magic, not semantic fields.

The floating-point scaling constants flt_5E74F0, flt_5E74F4, flt_5E74F8, dbl_5E7514 and dbl_5E752C have values absent from the packet; confirming the fixup math requires their numeric values. dbl_5E751C (0x005E751C) and tbyte_5E7534 (0x005E7534) are listed by the fact tables but absent from the decompiled bodies.

The lookup tables byte_5E74E0 (division overflow classification) and byte_5E74FC (remainder operand classification), and the 0xE000000/0x700/0x100 masks, are not fully derivable from packet evidence; x87 FPREM semantics provide only a DERIVED interpretation.

The virtual dispatch targets (vtable slots 2/4/5 and the locale sub-object dispatch at this+13, offset +52) are not statically resolved in the packet; the uflow/sputc/underflow names are analysis labels only.

The 'physics', 'locale', 'string' and 'callback' names attached to the globals read by the CRTCallbackThunks are ABI/analysis naming leads, not confirmed semantics; the shared helper BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) treats the pointer/global argument as a state token or validity signal.

ReadPEHeaderLinkerVersion (0x005930E8) writes a minor-linker-version byte at caller buffer offset +1; that field:this:0x00000001 reference is placed in unresolved_evidence_refs because it belongs to a caller-provided output buffer, not to any identified class.

The packet canonical label PEImageBaseAddressDetection for 0x005930E8 is a misnomer; the function reads the linker version, not the image base. PE32/PE32+ is not validated before reading optional-header bytes +26/+27.
